language.translationUnit: #include fixture.h followed by exactly int test(void) { return EXPR; }
language.preprocessor: fixture.h must contain exactly one #define BASE signed-i32 line
language.expressionGrammar: signed decimal i32 literals, BASE, parentheses, unary minus, *, +, -, <<, >>, &, ^, | with C precedence
language.typePolicy: one i32 expression; arithmetic and left shift have WebAssembly i32 wrap semantics; right shift is signed; division, pointers, calls, globals and undefined behavior are denied
language.shiftCountPolicy: each fully evaluated shift count must be in 0..31; negative counts and counts at least 32 fail closed instead of using WebAssembly masking
language.diagnosticPolicy: any byte or token outside the admitted grammar fails closed

counterContract.allocationUnit: compiler-owned mutable token or byte buffer allocated while compiling one program
counterContract.boundaryUnit: one host-to-Wasm compiler invocation input boundary or one emitted-byte output boundary

javascript-controlled.implementation: independent JavaScript tokenizer, recursive-descent parser, type gate, Wasm binary code generator and linker

wasm-self-hosted-controlled.implementation: material compiler running inside linear Wasm; source and header bytes enter its VFS boundary and emitted Wasm bytes leave it

limitations: This is a frozen, rights-clean C expression subset, not a claim to implement ISO C generally.
Cold-load and self-hosting results remain unavailable until retained browser evidence is collected.
Coverage remains unavailable until independent review and retained browser lifecycle evidence pass.
